liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Stella Blue leading out of The Other One was nice; Jerry botched the opening verse; Bobby called out 'combine'; Jerry kept jamming and it recovered by the cheap hotel line [22][29]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Looks Like Rain into Deal was outrageous [24]
- **Help On the Way** (1 review): Jerry plays at blazing speed during Help On The Way [22]
- **Eyes of the Word** (1 review): Eyes of the World has a different introduction than usual [22]
- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed the Space Jam immensely, asking friends whether they could feel the wind [26]

## The recordings

- **gd83-10-20.senn-silberman.skankweed.13164.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 181 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Described as one of the finest audience recordings the reviewer has heard; Very crisp audience recording [25][29]
- **gd1983-10-20.164900.senn441.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 174 min [2]
- **gd1983-10-20.143326.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: audience recording; 22 songs; 169 min [7]
- **gd83-10-20.nak701s.unknown.9960.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [12]. Said about its sound: Phil's bass sounds especially good during Stella Blue [33]
- **gd83-10-20.akg-mow.ford.28406.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [13]. Said about its sound: This recording's sound quality is high; reviewer favors it over other audience recordings' Help on the Way [32]

## Around the show

- Reviewer took blotter at second set start and lost friends and their ride afterward [26]
- Reviewer says this was the first Dead show at the newly opened Worcester Centrum [30]
- Reviewer says Jerry nodded off between The Other One and Stella Blue; Bobby tapped his shoulder [31]
- During Drums a security guard shouted at the tapers to stay down if they wanted to remain [7]
- Reviewer found this show solid, but the following night was the standout of the tour [23]
- Fans hoped for a St Stephen as played at the Garden a few nights earlier; it didn't come [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd83-10-20.senn-silberman.skankweed.13164.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jeff Silberman; transferred by Jeff Silberman; source: Audience: Sennheiser 441's [1]. Also: Source is a Sennheiser/Silberman recording; dropouts and digital noise removed from set one, with Day Job's end patched from another source [1]
- **gd1983-10-20.164900.senn441.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 441 mics + (1) Neumann U87 mic blend > Nakamichi 550 [2]. Also: A 5:33 patch in Drums comes from the Silberman/Miller Sennheiser 441 source; Other One space included [2]
- **gd1983-10-20.143326.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew Kyle Holbrook Tom Pinney Sean Murtha Chris Kidwell Greg Martens; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Master AUD/MC Beyer M201's X-Y 7'up > Sony TCD5M no dolby Maxell MX90 x 2 Location: 80 feet from stage, DFC ** patch source: AU/MC Sennheiser mke2002 headworn… [7]. Also: Beyer M201 recording, first generation from Kidwell's master; encore was missed [7]
- **gd83-10-20.nak701s.unknown.9960.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience: Nakamichi 701's [12]
- **gd83-10-20.akg-mow.ford.28406.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Doug Mow; transferred by Doug Mow and Alex Ford; source: Audience: AKG D224E [13]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1983-10-20 Thu Centrum, Worcester, MA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1418602122814/grateful-dead-1983-10-20-thu-centrum) [35]

Reviewer found this show solid, but the following night was the standout of the tour
Fans hoped for a St Stephen as played at the Garden a few nights earlier; it didn't come
Looks Like Rain into Deal was outrageous
Described as one of the finest audience recordings the reviewer has heard
Reviewer took blotter at second set start and lost friends and their ride afterward
Reviewer enjoyed the Space Jam immensely, asking friends whether they could feel the wind
Very crisp audience recording
Jerry botched the opening verse; Bobby called out 'combine'; Jerry kept jamming and it recovered by the cheap hotel line
Reviewer says this was the first Dead show at the newly opened Worcester Centrum
Reviewer says Jerry nodded off between The Other One and Stella Blue; Bobby tapped his shoulder
This recording's sound quality is high; reviewer favors it over other audience recordings' Help on the Way
Phil's bass sounds especially good during Stella Blue
Source is a Sennheiser/Silberman recording; dropouts and digital noise removed from set one, with Day Job's end patched from another source
Recorded by Rob Eaton with Neumann U87 and Sennheiser 441 blend; transfers by Eaton and Charlie Miller
A 5:33 patch in Drums comes from the Silberman/Miller Sennheiser 441 source; Other One space included
During Drums a security guard shouted at the tapers to stay down if they wanted to remain
Beyer M201 recording, first generation from Kidwell's master; encore was missed
